tasks.label: Expo: clean run (mobile)
tasks.command: APP_ENV=${input:appEnv} npx expo prebuild --clean --platform ${input:platform} --no-install && if [ "${input:platform}" = "ios" ]; then node scripts/fix-development-team.js && pnpm dlx pod-install ios; fi && APP_ENV=${input:appEnv} npx expo run:${input:platform}

tasks.label: Android: build release APK & install on device
tasks.command: export APP_ENV=${input:releaseEnv}; if [ "$APP_ENV" = "staging" ]; then export DEFAULT_NETWORK=testnet; fi; npx expo prebuild --platform android --no-install && (cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease) && apk=$(find android/app/build/outputs/apk -path '*release*' -name '*.apk' -print0 | xargs -0 ls -t 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$apk" ]; then echo 'Build produced no release APK.'; exit 1; fi; echo "Installing $apk"; adb install -r "$apk"

tasks.label: Install: latest IPA on iPhone
tasks.command: ipa=$(ls -t build/ios/*.ipa 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$ipa" ]; then echo 'No IPA found — run a fastlane build first.'; exit 1; fi; echo "Installing $ipa"; xcrun devicectl device install app --device ${input:iosDevice} "$ipa"

inputs.description: APP_ENV (must match the last prebuild for plain runs)
